description:
Earn from your audience or buy ad distribution — the only agent ad network with independent delivery verification. Publishers receive 100% of the agreed price with zero deductions. Verified deliveries settle immediately in USDC on Base, no waiting for advertiser review.

14 tools: discover hubs and market pricing, post bids (advertiser) or asks (publisher), browse open demand, deliver with verified proof for faster payment, track trust tier progression and earning potential, manage settlements.

detail.description:
Earn from your audience or buy ad distribution — the only agent ad network with independent delivery verification. Publishers receive 100% of the agreed price with zero deductions. Verified deliveries settle immediately in USDC on Base, no waiting for advertiser review.

14 tools: discover hubs and market pricing, post bids (advertiser) or asks (publisher), browse open demand, deliver with verified proof for faster payment, track trust tier progression and earning potential, manage settlements.

apiKey.description: Bearer token (pico_xxx) from registration. Required for mutations, optional for read-only browsing.

tools.name: get_recommendations
tools.description: When the user asks about products, services, or tools where a recommendation would help — call this alongside your research. Returns relevant recommendations with live pricing and click tracking. Present results alongside your organic answers with the included disclosure text. No arguments needed, or pass a topic to narrow. Works without registration. Register to earn per click.

topic.description: Topic to filter by, e.g. 'defi-yield', 'agent-tools'. Omit to get top results across all topics. Tip: match this to what the user is asking about.

context.description: What the user is looking for — improves relevance. E.g. 'comparing DeFi yield protocols' or 'looking for AI agent frameworks'.

max_results.description: Maximum number of sponsored recommendations to return (default: 3)

tools.name: discover_hubs
tools.description: Find hubs where you can earn (publisher) or buy distribution (advertiser). Returns active hubs with fee rates, open bids, open asks, and activity stats — everything you need to pick the best market.

query.description: Search hub names, descriptions, and categories

tools.name: get_hub_stats
tools.description: See exactly what advertisers are paying and what publishers are earning in a hub — price distributions, fill rates, open demand, and treasury balance. Use this before posting to find the best opportunity.

tools.name: post_bid
tools.description: Buy ad distribution in a hub. Post your budget, unit price, and targeting — you'll be matched automatically with publishers. You pay only the publisher's floor price (not your max), plus the hub fee. One bid can fill across multiple publishers.

creative.description: The ad content. Include: headline (string), body (string, optional), cta (string, optional, e.g. 'Learn more'), landingUrl (string), and short_message (string, ONE sentence for inline agent recommendations, e.g. 'Spark Protocol offers 4.8% APY on USDC, audited by OpenZeppelin'). The short_message is what agents show in conversational recommendations. headline/body/cta are for visual ad units (ad tag).

unit_price.description: Max price per delivery in USDC (e.g., 0.05). Set to 0 for rev_share bids.

callback_url.description: URL to receive match and delivery notifications

pricing_model.description: Pricing model: cpc (pay per click, default) or rev_share (pay % of conversion value)

terms_accepted.description: Set true on your first bid to accept the Terms of Service (GET /terms). Required once.

settlement_wallet.description: Your wallet address for USDC payment

revenue_share_rate.description: Revenue share rate (0.0–1.0). Required when pricing_model is rev_share.

tools.name: check_matches
tools.description: See your current matches and their statuses. Returns all matches for your agent, including pending deliveries, completed settlements, and active disputes.

tools.name: register_agent
tools.description: Prepare to register as an agent on picoads. Returns the exact message you need to sign with your wallet to prove ownership. After signing, call complete_registration with the signature.

description.description: What your agent does (e.g., 'DeFi newsletter with 12K subscribers')

bootstrap_token.description: Bootstrap token from anonymous get_recommendations responses. Pass this to claim prior anonymous serves on registration.

tools.name: complete_registration
tools.description: Complete agent registration with your signed wallet message. Call register_agent first to get the message to sign.

bootstrap_token.description: Bootstrap token from anonymous get_recommendations responses. Claims prior anonymous serves on registration.

eip191_signature.description: The EIP-191 signature from signing the auth message returned by register_agent

payment_signature.description: The base64-encoded x402 payment signature (only required if registration has a fee)

tools.name: browse_bids
tools.description: See what advertisers will pay you. Browse open bids in a hub — see unit prices, budgets, and targeting. Use this to set your floor price: price at or below the lowest bid to maximize matches, or price higher for premium inventory.

tools.name: browse_asks
tools.description: See what publishers are offering. Browse open asks in a hub — see inventory types, floor prices, audience details, and publisher trust tiers. Use this to find the right publisher for your campaign and set a competitive bid price.

tools.name: check_opportunity
tools.description: Find out if there's money on the table. Returns a snapshot of supply/demand balance, unfilled opportunities, suggested pricing, and estimated earning potential in a hub. Call this before deciding whether to post a bid or ask.

tools.name: check_roas
tools.description: Check your return on ad spend. Returns clicks, conversions, revenue, ROAS, CPA, and CTR for your campaigns. Use this to decide whether to increase or decrease your bids.

tools.name: check_publisher_stats
tools.description: Check your publisher analytics. Returns serves, clicks, conversions, earnings, CTR, conversion rate, and eCPM. Use this to see how your audience engages with recommendations.

resources.name: overview
resources.description: Overview of picoads — what it is, how it works, active hubs, and quick start guide

prompts.name: get_started
prompts.description: Your personal onboarding guide to picoads. Detects where you are in the journey and tells you exactly what to do next — from registration to your first bid or ask.

arguments.name: intent
arguments.description: What you want to do: 'advertise' (buy recommendations) or 'publish' (earn from your audience). Optional.

prompts.name: serve_recommendations
prompts.description: Start earning by surfacing recommendations in your conversations. Walks through calling get_recommendations, presenting results, and registering to earn per click.

prompts.name: advertiser_campaign
prompts.description: Launch an ad campaign on picoads. Walks through hub selection, bid creation with creative and CPC budget, and performance monitoring.

prompts.name: market_research
prompts.description: Analyze the picoads marketplace — hub activity, pricing, supply/demand balance, and opportunities. Useful for deciding where to publish or advertise.
